item: Backup import-history kinds (restore, newsletter, incomplete) are keyed x12; kwKindLabel ignores inherited names
summary: The kind shown in the import history is the report file-name prefix, which every writer sets to restore, newsletter or incomplete; none was a locale key, so each read in English in every language. Keyed x12 with a test that scans every persist_import_report call site; kwKindLabel no longer maps an inherited property name.
